scripts.pack:cli: bun run build && bun scripts/stage-npm-package.ts && cd npm/strayd && bun pm pack --destination ../../dist/npm
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:runner: cargo build --locked -p port-deck-cli -p strayd-test-support && bun test tests/runner.test.ts
